articles.title: “Vomiting Row Turns Violent!” Beer Bar Brawl in Nagpur Caught on CCTV
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Nagpur: A violent clash inside a beer bar in Maharashtra’s Nagpur district has gone viral on social media, showing a fierce fight between customers and staff over a trivial issue.

body.html:
Nagpur: A violent clash inside a beer bar in Maharashtra’s Nagpur district has gone viral on social media, showing a fierce fight between customers and staff over a trivial issue.

The incident took place at SK Beer Bar in the Hudkeshwar area, where a dispute reportedly broke out after a customer vomited inside the premises. According to reports, the argument began when a bar employee questioned who would clean the mess.

The customer allegedly responded that he would pay for the cleaning, which led to a heated exchange. The situation quickly escalated into a physical fight, with both sides engaging in kicks and punches. CCTV footage of the incident shows chaos inside the bar, with property also being vandalised during the clash.

Sources said some individuals had insisted on continuing to drink even after the bar had closed, further aggravating tensions.

Several people from both sides sustained injuries in the altercation.

Following the incident, bar staff lodged a complaint at Hudkeshwar Police Station. Police have registered a case against the accused and initiated an investigation.

The viral video has once again raised concerns over law and order and unruly behaviour in public places.

#Nagpur #Maharashtra #BarFight #ViralVideo #CCTV

articles.title: “Prasad Turned Poison!” Neighbour Arrested for Lacing Laddoos with Sleeping Pills in Surat
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Surat: The Surat Police have cracked the shocking “Prasad Poisoning Case” that had sent shockwaves through the upscale Shaligram States society, revealing that the accused was the victim family’s next-door neighbour.

body.html:
Surat: The Surat Police have cracked the shocking “Prasad Poisoning Case” that had sent shockwaves through the upscale Shaligram States society, revealing that the accused was the victim family’s next-door neighbour.

The आरोपी, identified as Ushaben Mahendrabhai Nakrani, allegedly confessed during interrogation to mixing a high dose of sleeping pills into boondi laddoos and leaving them at the doorstep of Goverdhanbhai Donda’s house on April 10, posing as a religious offering.

According to police, the act was premeditated and aimed at exploiting the family’s faith. Around 3:00 PM, Goverdhanbhai found a bag of laddoos hanging on his door and, assuming it to be prasad, brought it inside. He and his daughter-in-law, Kiran, consumed the sweets.

Within minutes, both began experiencing severe dizziness, nausea and collapsed. Goverdhanbhai’s condition turned critical, and he had to be put on ventilator support, while Kiran suffered intense weakness and disorientation.

The conspiracy came to light due to the alertness of the family’s daughter, Isha. Sensing something unusual, she broke open the remaining laddoos and found three to four intact tablets hidden inside each piece. She immediately informed the family and alerted the police, providing key evidence for investigation.

During the probe, it was revealed that Ushaben allegedly held a grudge against the Donda family. About eight months ago, her daughter had eloped for a love marriage, and she suspected that Kiran had helped her. Police believe this suspicion led to the planned act of revenge.

A case has been registered under Section 123 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for causing hurt by means of poison.

The Donda family remains traumatised. “If we had eaten one more laddoo, the entire family could have been wiped out,” Kiran said. The family has urged authorities to ensure their safety and take strict action, even requesting that the accused be removed from the locality.

#Surat #PoisoningCase #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: “‘Don’t Make Video!’—MLA’s Son Accused After Thar Hits 5 in Shivpuri, FIR Filed”
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Shivpuri: In a major development in the Karera accident case, police have registered an FIR against Dinesh Lodhi, son of BJP MLA Pritam Lodhi, after his Thar car allegedly hit five people in Madhya Pradesh’s Shivpuri district on Thursday (April 17, 2026).

body.html:
Shivpuri: In a major development in the Karera accident case, police have registered an FIR against Dinesh Lodhi, son of BJP MLA Pritam Lodhi, after his Thar car allegedly hit five people in Madhya Pradesh’s Shivpuri district on Thursday (April 17, 2026).

The incident occurred around 7:30 AM in the Karera police station area. According to the complaint filed by Sanjay Parihar, a resident of Sanheda in Datia, he and his friends Ashish Parihar and Anshul Parihar were travelling by motorcycle to Thanra village for work. Ahead of them, Sita Verma and Pooja Soni were walking on the road.

A Thar vehicle coming from behind allegedly rammed into the motorcycle, causing the three men to fall. The SUV then hit the two women pedestrians, leaving all five injured. Locals rushed to the spot and took the injured to hospital.

The victims sustained multiple injuries. While the three youth suffered injuries to their arms, legs and head, Sita Verma and Pooja Soni sustained injuries to their waist, shoulders and head.

Injured Ashish Parihar and Anshul Parihar alleged that Dinesh Lodhi was driving the vehicle, which reportedly had “Pritam Lodhi” written on the front and “MLA” on the rear. They further claimed that after the accident, the accused argued with them and issued threats.

A video from the scene has surfaced, in which the accused is allegedly heard questioning the victims for not moving aside despite the siren and horn. He is also purportedly heard telling bystanders, “Don’t make a video,” and asking them to switch off their cameras.

Following the incident, MLA Pritam Lodhi reacted on social media, stating, “For an MLA, a son is not family. The public is paramount. The police administration should ensure justice for the victims of Karera.”

Police have registered a case under Crime No. 255/26 against Dinesh Lodhi under Sections 281 and 125(A) of the IPC. Further investigation is underway.

#Shivpuri #MadhyaPradesh #RoadAccident #MLASon #BreakingNews

articles.title: “Missing Woman Found as Skeleton!” Shocking Discovery in Nelamangala Raises Murder Suspicion
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru Rural: In a disturbing development, the skeletal remains of a 35-year-old woman were discovered in Hale Nijgal village in Nelamangala taluk, raising strong suspicions of murder.

body.html:
Bengaluru Rural: In a disturbing development, the skeletal remains of a 35-year-old woman were discovered in Hale Nijgal village in Nelamangala taluk, raising strong suspicions of murder.

The deceased has been identified as Yamuna, a native of Tumakuru, who had been missing for several days. Police recovered her skull along with bones of the hands and legs near an areca nut plantation. A bag and an ID card found at the spot helped confirm her identity.

According to police, Yamuna was married to Mallikarjun around 19 years ago and had two children. However, she had reportedly separated from her husband eight years ago after entering into a relationship with a man identified as Raghavendra. She lived with him in Doddaballapura for nearly five years before returning to her husband’s house two years ago.

On March 21, which was her birthday, Yamuna allegedly went to meet Raghavendra after he insisted on meeting her. She went missing the same day, following which a missing complaint was registered at Kyathasandra Police Station in Tumakuru.

Preliminary investigation suggests that Yamuna may have been murdered, and her body was dumped near the plantation in an attempt to destroy evidence.

Family members, who were alerted by the police, identified the remains at the scene.

Dabaspet police visited the spot and conducted a detailed inspection. A case has been registered, and efforts are underway to trace the accused and establish the exact sequence of events.

#Bengaluru #Nelamangala #MurderMystery #MissingWoman #CrimeNews

articles.title: “CCTV Exposes Daylight Heist!” Masked Trio Loot ₹1.08 Lakh After Holding Woman Hostage in Jalandhar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Jalandhar: In a daring daylight robbery, three masked miscreants looted ₹1.08 lakh from a travel agency in the Harnamdaspura area under Police Station No. 2 limits. The incident took place at the ‘West End Western Union Tour and Travel’ shop and was captured on CCTV.

body.html:
Jalandhar: In a daring daylight robbery, three masked miscreants looted ₹1.08 lakh from a travel agency in the Harnamdaspura area under Police Station No. 2 limits. The incident took place at the ‘West End Western Union Tour and Travel’ shop and was captured on CCTV.

According to police, one of the accused, wearing a black shirt and covering his face with a handkerchief, first entered the shop on the pretext of enquiring about tickets. Shortly after, his accomplice entered, while a third accused stood guard outside on an Activa scooter.

CCTV footage shows that when the female employee got busy on a phone call, one of the accused suddenly grabbed her from behind and covered her mouth. The duo then took cash amounting to ₹1.08 lakh from the safe and fled the spot.

Investigations revealed that the accused had conducted a recce of the shop earlier in the afternoon and executed the robbery at around 6:22 PM.

Acting on CCTV evidence, police arrested one of the accused, identified as Gurdeep, a resident of the West constituency. The operation, led by ACP Ajay Singh, is ongoing, and raids are being conducted to apprehend the remaining accused.

#Jalandhar #Robbery #CCTVFootage #CrimeNews #PunjabPolice

articles.title: “Pregnant Woman Beaten by Cop?” Viral Video from Ballia Sparks Outrage, Police Under Fire
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ballia: A shocking incident from Uttar Pradesh’s Ballia district has triggered widespread outrage after a video surfaced showing a police constable allegedly assaulting a woman in the Bansdih police station area.

body.html:
Ballia: A shocking incident from Uttar Pradesh’s Ballia district has triggered widespread outrage after a video surfaced showing a police constable allegedly assaulting a woman in the Bansdih police station area.

The incident reportedly took place on April 13, when a Dial 112 team reached the spot following information about a land dispute. In the viral video, constable Sujit Kumar is allegedly seen kicking and punching the woman, identified as Pooja Patel, a resident of Sarangpur.

According to the victim, her only “fault” was questioning the police for taking her uncle, Rajendra Patel, into custody. She claimed she pleaded with folded hands, asserting his innocence, but was instead assaulted by the constable.

In her complaint to the Superintendent of Police (SP), Pooja Patel stated that a land dispute related to Arazi No. 45 in Mouza Kharauni is currently pending before the Ballia Civil Court. She alleged that the opposing party was attempting to carry out construction on the disputed land, which her family resisted.

The victim further claimed that although she initially called Dial 112 and police had advised both parties to maintain peace, the opposing side later called police from the station and, allegedly after paying a “facilitation fee,” resumed construction work.

She accused the police of acting in collusion with the opposing party. As per her allegations, her uncle was taken to the police station, detained, beaten and challaned in a one-sided action.

Pooja Patel also stated that she is pregnant and had requested a medical examination to assess the condition of her unborn child after the alleged assault. However, she claimed her request was denied and she was driven away from the police station using abusive language.

The presence of the opposing party at the scene during the incident has also been alleged, with claims that CCTV footage is available.

Following the viral video, serious questions are being raised about police conduct and accountability. The victim has demanded strict action against the accused constable, but as of now, no official statement has been issued by the administration.

#Ballia #UttarPradesh #PoliceBrutality #ViralVideo #JusticeForPooja

articles.title: “WhatsApp Plot Behind Noida Violence?” Labour Group Members Arrested as Protests Turn Violent
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Noida: The Noida Police have arrested Rupesh Rai and Manisha, members of the left-wing labour group Mazdoor Bigul Dasta, in connection with recent worker protests over low wages that escalated into violence, including arson and disruption of factory operations.

body.html:
Noida: The Noida Police have arrested Rupesh Rai and Manisha, members of the left-wing labour group Mazdoor Bigul Dasta, in connection with recent worker protests over low wages that escalated into violence, including arson and disruption of factory operations.

According to officials, the protests began peacefully in early April 2026 across industrial sectors such as 60, 63, 84 and 140, with workers demanding wage hikes. However, the situation later turned violent, with incidents of road blockades, vandalism and fires reported from multiple locations.

During the investigation, police uncovered alleged premeditated planning through at least 17 WhatsApp groups. These groups were reportedly used to incite workers and coordinate shutdowns. So far, more than 300 people have been arrested, including 18 individuals linked directly to these digital groups.

Rupesh Rai, identified as the main accused, was detained after police recovered WhatsApp chats from his phone allegedly showing messages instigating unrest. Officials said planning for the protests began in early April through union meetings.

Manisha was arrested along with Rupesh, Aakriti and Srishti on April 11 near the Botanical Garden Metro Station following a demonstration. Police also detained several other women activists aged between 25 and 30, and noted the involvement of “external elements” in escalating the unrest.

Police said Mazdoor Bigul Dasta, a labour mobilisation group reportedly based in Lucknow, had been active across industrial areas and is suspected of turning peaceful protests violent. The group has also been linked to previous incidents in Haryana.

Authorities further stated that three groups in total have been identified in connection with the unrest, which led to forced factory closures despite some worker demands reportedly being met. Digital evidence from the WhatsApp groups is currently under forensic examination.

The investigation is ongoing, and officials said strict action will be taken against those found responsible.

#Noida #LabourProtest #MazdoorBigulDasta #Violence #WhatsAppChats

articles.title: “Tied Upside Down & Beaten!” Mob Brutality in Bihar’s Buxar Sparks Outrage After Viral Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Buxar: A shocking case of mob violence has emerged from Bihar’s Buxar district, where a young man was allegedly tied upside down to a tree and brutally assaulted by villagers on suspicion of theft.

body.html:
Buxar: A shocking case of mob violence has emerged from Bihar’s Buxar district, where a young man was allegedly tied upside down to a tree and brutally assaulted by villagers on suspicion of theft.

The incident took place late Sunday (12 April 2026) night in Gurudas Mathiya village under the Mufassil police station limits. According to reports, the youth was caught by locals around 3:00 AM, who accused him of attempting theft.

Eyewitnesses claimed that villagers took the law into their own hands, tied the man to a tree using a rope, and severely beat him. A video of the incident has since gone viral on social media, triggering widespread outrage and raising serious concerns over law and order.

Police said they reached the spot in the morning after receiving information, rescued the injured youth, and shifted him to a hospital for treatment.

The victim has been identified as Betani Yadav, a resident of the same village. However, his family has denied the theft allegations, claiming he was falsely targeted due to an old personal enmity and that the incident was part of a conspiracy.

Buxar Superintendent of Police Shubham Arya stated that the viral video is being examined and that an FIR is being registered. “Strict action will be taken against those found guilty,” he said.

Police have launched a detailed investigation to determine the exact sequence of events and identify all those involved in the assault.

#Bihar #Buxar #MobLynching #ViralVideo #CrimeNews

articles.title: “Commission Row Explodes!” BJP Corporators Clash Inside PMC Over ‘Percentage Cut’ Allegations
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Pune: Allegations of “percentage cuts” in civic works resurfaced at the Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) on Wednesday after a heated clash between two BJP women corporators over a project in Baner came to light.

body.html:
Pune: Allegations of “percentage cuts” in civic works resurfaced at the Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) on Wednesday after a heated clash between two BJP women corporators over a project in Baner came to light.

The incident, which involved a verbal spat, abuse and chaotic scenes inside the PMC building department, has triggered a political storm after a video of the altercation went viral on social media.

The dispute is linked to an under-construction residential education centre for tribal girl students in Baner. Officials stated that nearly 85–90% of the project has already been completed. A tender worth around ₹3 crore for the remaining work has been approved by the standing committee.

Tensions escalated at the final stage of the project over alleged demands for a “percentage cut”. Former corporator Rajashree Kale, who has been following up on the project, visited the PMC office on Wednesday where sitting corporator Rohini Chimte and the contractor were present.

An argument broke out between Kale and Chimte regarding the execution of the remaining work, which soon turned into a heated exchange with allegations and counter-allegations.

Kale alleged that the project was being deliberately stalled due to commission demands. She claimed that despite the project nearing completion, attempts were being made to delay the work over “percentage” issues, and that pressure was being exerted on the contractor to halt work until the alleged payment was made.

Chimte, however, denied the allegations, stating that the disagreement was over pending work related to the compound wall. She said the boundary wall remains incomplete, causing inconvenience to nearby residents, and maintained that she had only insisted on completing that portion first.

The incident has intensified political tensions within the civic body, with the viral video drawing public attention to alleged irregularities in municipal works.

#Pune #PMC #BJP #PoliticalClash #PercentageCut
